name: AWS Lambda
explanation: Real! Run code without managing servers, billed per request and compute time.

name: Amazon DynamoDB
explanation: Real! A serverless key-value and document database with single-digit millisecond latency.

name: Amazon Pizza Delivery Service
explanation: Made up. Sadly, there is no PDS. Yet.

name: AWS Unicorn Hatchery
explanation: Made up. Startups are on their own here.

name: Amazon S3
explanation: Real! Simple Storage Service launched in 2006, one of the very first AWS services.

name: Amazon EC2
explanation: Real! Elastic Compute Cloud: virtual servers since 2006.

name: Amazon Elastic Banana
explanation: Made up. Elastic Beanstalk is real; Elastic Banana is just a snack.

name: AWS Cloud Kitten
explanation: Made up. Cute, though.

name: Amazon Rekognition
explanation: Real! Image and video analysis, spelled with a k.

name: AWS Step Functions
explanation: Real! Visual workflows that orchestrate AWS services.

name: AWS Lambda Lounge
explanation: Made up. Lambda is real; the lounge is not.

name: Amazon Data Sponge
explanation: Made up. It would absorb your data lake, presumably.

name: Amazon Kendra
explanation: Real! Intelligent enterprise search powered by ML.

name: AWS Outposts
explanation: Real! AWS infrastructure installed in your own data center.

name: AWS Insight Fabric
explanation: Made up. Sounds like a keynote slide, though.

name: Amazon Elastic Relay
explanation: Made up. Plausible, but no such service.

name: AWS Ground Station
explanation: Real! Control satellites and ingest their data as a managed service.

name: AWS Snowmobile
explanation: Real, now retired: a 45-foot shipping container on a truck for exabyte migrations.

name: AWS Orbit Relay
explanation: Made up. Ground Station is the real space service.

name: Amazon Signal Vault
explanation: Made up. No vault, no signal.

name: Amazon Honeycode
explanation: Real, now retired: a no-code app builder based on spreadsheets.

name: AWS Wickr
explanation: Real! End-to-end encrypted messaging for enterprises.

name: AWS Fleet Ledger
explanation: Made up. Convincing, right?

name: Amazon Lattice Studio
explanation: Made up. VPC Lattice is real; Lattice Studio is not.
